from collections import defaultdict
node_neighbors = defaultdict(lambda: defaultdict(list))
for a,b,t in window_events:
    node_neighbors[a][b].append(t)
    node_neighbors[b][a].append(t)

instances = []
for i,x in enumerate(entities):
    for y in entities[i+1:]:
        if x not in node_neighbors or y not in node_neighbors:
            continue
        # potential z are intersection of neighbors
        neigh_x = set(node_neighbors[x].keys())
        neigh_y = set(node_neighbors[y].keys())
        common = neigh_x & neigh_y
        for z in common:
            times_zx = node_neighbors[z][x]  # times between z and x
            times_zy = node_neighbors[z][y]
            # for each supporting interaction pair
            for tzx in times_zx:
                for tzy in times_zy:
                    t_support = max(tzx,tzy)
                    # closing times between x and y
                    times_xy = node_neighbors[x].get(y,[])
                    for t_cl in times_xy:
                        if t_cl>t_support and t_cl - t_support <=800:
                            instances.append({'x':x,'y':y,'z':z,'tzx':tzx,'tzy':tzy,'t_support':t_support,'t_close':t_cl})

print('window events', len(window_events))
print('found instances', len(instances))
for inst in instances[:100]:
    print(inst)

# print counts for entities
for n in entities:
    cnt = sum(len(v) for v in node_neighbors[n].values()) if n in node_neighbors else 0
    print('node',n,'degree interactions count',cnt)
print('done')
